# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a handsome, showy young lady with a plump figure, a brilliant complexion, and large, bright-blue eyes. She has a long yellow braid of flowing hair that she styles up in town, though her mother requires her to take it down at home.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and enjoys life's pleasantries openly, though she is prone to hysterics when alarmed. She is quite sentimental in her writing and thoughts, and is obsessively focused on young men, suitors, and romance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Traits

- good-tempered  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- cheerful  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- sentimental  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>
- prone to hysterics  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016)</sub>
- fear of caterpillars  <sub>[v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>

## Abilities

- charming away warts with a magic pebble  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- to have a beau as soon as she turned fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- to have dozens of suitors and a gay time before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- to teach for two years and then get married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

During her school days at Avonlea, Ruby participated in school plays, dialogues, and a story club alongside her friends Anne, Diana, and Jane. After studying for her teaching license at Queen's Academy, she accepted a teaching post at Carmody. While she attracted numerous suitors, she rejected Nelson Atkins after discovering his proposal came from an etiquette guide.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)_
